elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Python code snippet showing import statements for pandas and adfuller, reading an Excel file 'MonthlyCoalConsumption.xlsx', and performing Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) tests on the original data, first difference, and second difference of the 'Value' column. The code prints the ADF statistic and p-value for each differencing level (d=0, d=1, d=2).
elements.summary: This code demonstrates how to use Python to test the stationarity of a time series dataset by applying the ADF test at different levels of differencing, illustrating the process of identifying the order of differencing needed for ARIMA modeling.
